assumptions.limits: Authored fixed frictionless polyline guides at 2 mm source-cortex offset with 0.1 mm segment clearance; 10% trimming only at source insertion endpoints. No tendon radius, friction, sliding-wrap topology or measured anatomical path. Fixed guides carry support reactions; moving guides carry joint torque. Routes must pass each finite pose audit.
